name: Nadi International Airport
before:
Fiji's main international airport and an important regional hub for the South Pacific, at Namaka 10 km from Nadi and 20 km from Lautoka. It handles about 97 per cent of international visitors to Fiji, of whom 86 per cent are tourists.

The thing to plan around is the distance to the capital. Suva, Fiji's largest city, is 192 km south east of Nadi and has its own airport at Nausori. A client heading for Suva faces a long transfer or a domestic hop, so do not assume Nadi is close to everything.

It is the main hub for Fiji Airways and its regional subsidiary Fiji Link, which between them reach six airports across the south west Pacific and many more around the Pacific Rim. In 2019 the airport handled 2,485,319 passengers.

The runway is capable enough that a Qantas A380 made an emergency landing here in 2008 to offload a sick passenger, despite the airport not being certified for the type.
after:
Fiji's main international airport and a regional hub for the Pacific islands, at Namaka, north east of Nadi town and about 20 km from Lautoka. It handles about 97 per cent of the country's international passengers.

The thing to plan around is the distance to the capital, Suva, which is more than 110 km away and has its own airport at Nausori. A client heading there faces a long transfer or a domestic hop, so do not assume Nadi is close to everything.

The national airline, Fiji Airways, flies the widest network from here; its subsidiary Fiji Link covers domestic and regional routes. Fiji Airports, which runs the airport, says it serves more than 2.4 million passengers a year.

claims.note: Was 'an important regional hub for the South Pacific'. The operator's 2024 annual report calls Nadi 'a hub for the blue Pacific' (the Pacific Islands Forum's name for the island region), and oneworld says Fiji Link flies on to Tonga, Samoa, Tuvalu and Vanuatu; 'important' is Wikipedia's word alone and is dropped. The operator's history page also says 'a major regional hub for the South Pacific islands', but that page closely paraphrases Wikipedia's article (the 1939 airstrips, the South Pacific air ferry route, the drier west coast, 'Colony of Fiji: Nadi Airport', and its hub sentence almost word for word), so it is not counted.

claims.claim: Fiji Airports says the airport serves more than 2.4 million passengers a year
claims.inAfter: Fiji Airports, which runs the airport, says it serves more than 2.4 million passengers a year.
claims.note: Was 'In 2019 the airport handled 2,485,319 passengers' (Wikipedia's infobox, from the operator; the operator's 2019 report sits on its old airportsfiji.com site, whose pages now show a PHP error). A passenger total for a passenger total, attributed: the operator's 2024 annual report (letter of 9 June 2025) says Nadi 'now serves more than 2.4 million passengers annually', and its live Nadi page gives more than 2.1 million international and close to 300,000 domestic passengers a year. The operator's figure looks like a floor: the same report counts 2,895,185 international passenger movements across all its airports in 2024, up 9.3 per cent, and says 97 per cent of international arrivals come through Nadi. No Nadi-only total for 2024 or 2025 was found.
